## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the nucleus-sampling (top-p) cutoff of a [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) as part of its provenance.

### Avoid when

- Avoid placing it on the model agent or card (it is per-invocation) and avoid conflating it with [`gmeow:samplingTemperature`](gmeow-samplingTemperature.md) — they are independent sampling controls.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:samplingTopP`](gmeow-samplingTopP.md) as a decimal on the [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) alongside the other sampling parameters.

### Examples

- ex:inv1 [`gmeow:samplingTopP`](gmeow-samplingTopP.md) 0.95.
